terms.title: Terms of use
terms.body:
## Who we are and what we do
Aklatak is an online intermediary platform that introduces customers to independent home cooks, restaurants and shops near them, and connects them directly through WhatsApp.

## Aklatak is not a party to the order
The platform does not prepare, sell or deliver food, and does not collect its price. The order, price, quantity, quality, delivery and payment are agreed directly between the customer and the subscriber, under their own responsibility.

## Responsibilities of subscribers (cooks, restaurants, shops)
- Hold every licence and health permit required in their country and follow food safety and hygiene rules.
- Disclose ingredients, especially allergens, when asked.
- Keep the information, photos and prices on their page accurate.
- Respect customers and the agreements made with them.

## Responsibilities of customers
- Ask about ingredients before ordering if they have an allergy or a medical condition.
- Agree clearly with the subscriber on the order, payment and delivery.

## Limitation of liability
To the extent permitted by law, Aklatak is not liable for the quality, safety or timeliness of food, for any harm resulting from it, or for any dispute between a customer and a subscriber. Ratings are the opinions of their authors.

## Subscriptions and accounts
A subscription allows a profile to be shown for the paid period. Aklatak may review accounts and hide, suspend or delete any account that breaches these terms or receives serious complaints.

## Complaints
Complaints and notes can be sent from the cook's or restaurant's page; they reach the Aklatak team only.

## Changes
We may update these terms; continuing to use the platform means accepting the updated version.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.body:
## What we collect
- From subscribers: name, WhatsApp number, business location, towns they deliver to, photos and menu.
- From customers: the request text and an approximate location (about 1 km) used for the search only. We don't ask customers for a name or number, and we don't store their address.

## How we use it
- To show the nearest subscribers and connect customers with them on WhatsApp.
- For general statistics that help subscribers see how many people visited their page.

## What we don't do
- We never sell data.
- Subscribers never see the customer's location — only the name of their area.
- Customers never see the cook's or restaurant's location — only an approximate distance.

## Your rights
You can ask to access, correct or delete your data by contacting the Aklatak team.

## Security
Passwords are hashed, connections are encrypted, and data access is limited to the administration.

about.title: About us
about.body:
Aklatak brings home subscribers together with the customers near them, in any country.

Tell us what you're craving or find a restaurant nearby, and we'll connect you directly with the one who makes it — on WhatsApp.

driver.safety:
• Always wear a helmet
• Carry a closed delivery bag to keep orders safe (required — a store may remove you from an order without one)
• Follow traffic law, drive safely, no phone while driving
• Deliver orders intact and closed; be respectful
• Vehicle papers, licence, registration, insurance and any permits are your sole responsibility
• The platform is not responsible for any accident, damage or offence during your work

legal.terms:
Aklatak is an online intermediary that connects customers with stores and independent drivers. The platform does not sell, prepare or deliver any product.

Stores: each store is fully responsible for its products, their quality, prices, safety and its licences, including prescription medicines and age-restricted goods. Stores pay a subscription with no commission on orders and set the delivery fee the customer pays.

Drivers: drivers are independent, not employees of the platform, and are responsible for their vehicle, licence, insurance, conduct on the road, traffic law and wearing a helmet.

Customers: the customer pays the order plus the delivery fee, either in cash to the driver on delivery or by card when ordering (where available). Details and address must be correct; fake orders are forbidden.

Cash payments: the food/product money a driver collects belongs to the store, not to the driver; the delivery fee is the driver's. The driver hands the stores' money over by a settlement whose amount and split per store the system computes automatically: either paid inside the app through a fixed-amount link (Whish, OMT or card), confirmed automatically as soon as the payment provider confirms that exact amount arrived, or by a manual transfer (or a method the platform sets for his country) that counts only after the team verifies it. A settlement with a non-matching amount is never accepted, and every irregular attempt is logged. Once confirmed, each store is credited its share, which is sent to the receiving number it set, if any. When the stores' money a driver holds reaches or passes the set limit (200 $ by default), he gets no new cash orders until he settles.

Card payments: paid electronically through the payment provider; after the order is completed the food money is credited to the store's account and the delivery fee to the driver's. A payment counts only when the provider confirms it. A paid order that is cancelled or rejected is refunded to the customer.

Confirming receipt: an order is complete when the customer confirms receipt, or automatically after the set time. If the store reports an order as not delivered, its money is frozen until the team decides (complete or refund). No financial record is deleted; corrections are made with recorded reversal entries.

Accounts and withdrawals: the platform receives card payments and settlements only as a collection agent for stores and drivers, without any commission; account holders can withdraw their balance to any Whish or OMT number after confirming their password. The account holder is responsible for keeping the password safe; the platform is not liable for a withdrawal made with the correct password. Every withdrawal and settlement is logged.

Complaints and warnings: customers can complain about a store or a driver, stores about a driver, drivers about a store. The team may suspend or hide any account that breaks these terms; an account is suspended automatically after three warnings within the set period.

Liability: the platform is not responsible for products, deliveries or damage arising from them; its role is limited to running the technical service.

Appointments and craftspeople: appointments are confirmed by the business in the app and either side may cancel; craftspeople are responsible for their work and prices.

Google Play payments: only the subscribers' subscription may be paid through Google Play. Settlements and withdrawals go through Whish or OMT and are unrelated to the subscription.

Direct driver requests: a customer can ask a driver to deliver something, bring something from a shop, or run an errand, at a price the customer sets. Payment is directly between customer and driver; the platform receives no money and does not guarantee payment. A driver never has to buy anything out of pocket unless they agree. Passenger transport and illegal items are forbidden; drivers may refuse any request.

Driver basics: a helmet and a delivery bag are required; a store may remove a driver who lacks them, giving a reason. Vehicle papers, licence, registration, insurance and all permits are the driver's sole responsibility; the platform is not liable for accidents, damage or offences.

Branches: each branch has its own location, page, orders and records. Each extra branch adds a percentage of the subscription price set by the team.

These terms may be updated; continuing to use the service means you accept them.
legal.privacy:
What we collect: name and phone number, your location when you order, and order details. For drivers: documents and vehicle photos, and location only while available.

Why: to deliver your order, let the store and driver reach you, and protect users.

Who sees what: the store sees your name, number and location. Your exact location reaches only the driver who accepted your order, after the store sends it. Driver documents are private and seen only by the platform owner for verification. We never sell your data.

Location: a driver's location is recorded only while “available”. Home cooks' and craftspeople's homes are never shown.

Deletion: delete your account any time from Account → Delete my account. Order records stay without your personal details.

On your phone: we keep only your session and language; the cart empties when you close the app.

Chat: messages between customer and driver are private to them; the platform owner reads them only if a complaint is filed about that request.
legal.about: Aklatak connects you with restaurants, cafés, pharmacies and shops near you, and delivers through independent drivers. Stores pay a fixed subscription with no commission, so prices stay the same as in the store.
